name: Messier 110
tagline: Andromeda's second bright satellite — a dwarf elliptical holding faint dusty structures and globular clusters of its own.
history: M110 is Andromeda's other classical companion — a dwarf elliptical larger than M32 but less centrally compressed, with faint traces of dust and a handful of globular clusters orbiting it. Its diffuse stars and peculiar velocity suggest a long gravitational relationship with M31; deep imaging shows tidal debris in its outskirts, evidence that it, too, is being slowly digested by the giant it attends.
